notes: Configurable probe texts and cbx controls per universal-scorer emotion. Crying and seductive lines match cloning-v2/scorer-probe/lines.json (read, not edited). Special tokens are official Chatterbox Turbo tokenizer added_tokens only. pace is the cbx --pace token-space duration factor (>1 slower).
